title: PolicyProfile
description: Named policy profile (P3-E4-S02 / D-017 B3): a coherent activation of packs distinct from the enforcing route. `spec.writes` is required — true holds forge write authority (approve/merge/block) for bindings in scope; false is recorder-only (counterfactual evaluation, never Reconcile). Single-writer invariant: for any given (environment, class) binding, exactly one active profile must resolve writes:true — zero or more than one is an assent lint hard error (`single-writer-profile`), never last-one-wins. Scope fields compose with ADR-0008 routing via the Config.profiles precedence table; profiles are not a second match/routing block.

writes.description: true = this profile authorizes forge writes for bindings in its scope; false = recorder-only. Required — no default. Lint hard-errors if zero or more than one writes:true profile covers the same (environment, class) binding (docs/planning/lint-hard-errors.md → single-writer-profile).

environments.description: Environment names this profile covers (Config environments[].name), or "*" for all environments.

classes.description: Change-class names this profile covers (Config classes[].name), or "*" for all classes.

packs.description: Optional coherent pack activation under this profile. When set, evaluation for covered bindings uses these packs; RulesetBinding remains the routing source of truth for which packs bind to (class, environment) — this field names the profile's activation set for comparison, not a parallel route.
